index.title: Manage Tasks with a Chatbot
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Tasks Chatbot. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Manage Tasks with a Chatbot. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different job,
index.what_happened_excerpt: A user created a chatbot that integrated with a web service to manage tasks. The chatbot checked task status and documented the results in a table. This job is the public pattern for managing tasks with a chatbot.
